title: A 6-hour trek to deliver aid, hope to Bukidnon Lumad pupils
summary: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — A municipal outreach team hiked for six hours through slippery mountain trails to deliver school supplies, slippers, and hot meals to 110 pupils from Indigenous Peoples (IP)…

blocks.text: SAN FERNANDO, Bukidnon — A municipal outreach team hiked for six hours through slippery mountain trails to deliver school supplies, slippers, and hot meals to 110 pupils from Indigenous Peoples (IP) communities in two remote hinterland schools in this town. The beneficiaries—composed of Tigwahanon, Matigsalug, and Manobo learners—are enrolled at Sil-angon Mission School in Sitio
